title: Independent gas-phase TD-DFT test of acid/base optical switching in dye 2a
difficulty_reasons: The endpoint structures and four-state observables are fixed, but the agent must plan an independent calculation, validate charged-state inputs and assign brightest states.

data.description: Complete XYZ geometries for named 2a-acid (+2, singlet) and 2a-base (-2, singlet) S0 structures.
